# iliad-118 — new renderings (Iliad 18.202–309)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἀπάτερθε (18.217) | "apart" | "apart from him" | "aloof", "far off"; the plain adverb |
| ὀπίζομαι (ὠπίζετ’ ἐφετμήν, 18.216) | "respected" | "respected" | "feared", "revered", "dreaded"; the verb covers regard and awe, and "respected" decides neither |
| πυκινὴν ἐφετμήν (18.216) | "shrewd command" | "shrewd command" | "close-packed" (kept for the literal sense of πυκινός), "wise"; follows the table’s πυκινὴν … βουλήν "shrewd plan" (2.55) |
| ὄσσοντο … ἄλγεα (18.224) | "foreboded pains" | "foresaw pains" | "feared", "sensed"; ὄσσομαι "see in the mind, foresee" |
| κυκήθησαν (18.229) | "were thrown into confusion" | "were thrown into confusion" | "were stirred up" (kept for ὀρίνθη), "were shaken", "were scattered" |
| ἔκπληγεν (18.225) | "were astounded" | "were astounded" | "were terrified" (keeps φόβος apart), "were struck dumb" |
| ὑπόδρα … προσέφη (18.284) | published (iliad-074) | published | none; the whole unit takes the shipped English |
| λεχέεσσι / φέρτρῳ (18.233, 18.236) | "bed" / "bier" | "bed" / "bier" | "couch", "litter"; the note says both name the one bier |
| ἠελίῳ καταδύντι (18.210) | "with the sun having set" | "when the sun has set" | "at sunset"; the aorist participle is kept in `l` |
| ἐπήτριμοι (πυρσοί, 18.211) | "close-set" | "close together" | "thick", "numerous", "frequent"; ἐπήτριμος "close-set, crowded" |
| περικτιόνεσσιν (18.212) | "the dwellers-around" | "the neighbours" | "the people round about" |
| ἄρεω ἀλκτῆρες (18.213) | "warders-off of ruin" | "a defence against ruin" | "of war", "helpers in war"; ἄρεω read as ἀρή "ruin", as ἀρῆς ἀλκτῆρα at 18.100 (the note says the other reading, Ἄρης "war", is possible) |
| ἄσπετον κυδοιμόν (18.218) | "a boundless uproar" | "a boundless uproar" | "unspeakable", "immense"; follows the table’s ἄσπετος "boundless" and κυδοιμός "uproar" |
| ἀριζήλη φωνή (18.219, 18.221) | "conspicuous voice" | "conspicuous voice" | "clear", "far-heard"; follows the table’s ἀρίζηλος "conspicuous" |
| θυμοραϊστέων (δηΐων, 18.220) | "life-destroying" | "life-destroying" | "heart-shattering"; follows the table’s θυμοραϊστής "life-destroying" (13.544) |
| Πανθοΐδης (18.250) | "Panthous’-son" | "son of Panthous" | follows the table’s Πανθοΐδης (13.756) |
| ὅρα πρόσσω καὶ ὀπίσσω (18.250) | "looked forward and backward" | "looked both forward and back" | "saw the future and the past" (decides what the Greek leaves open) |
| ῥηΐτεροι πολεμίζειν (18.258) | "easier to fight" | "easier to fight" | "weaker", "less formidable"; ῥηΐδιος "easy" |
| χαίρεσκον … ἰαύων (18.259) | "used to rejoice, sleeping" | "used to be glad to sleep" | "slept gladly"; the iterative -σκον kept as "used to", as in the table’s ἰαύεσκον |
| αἰνῶς δείδοικα (18.261) | "dreadfully I fear" | "I am dreadfully afraid" | "terribly" (table has "dreadfully, terribly" for αἰνῶς; "dreadfully" chosen) |
| ὑπέρβιος (θυμός, 18.262) | "exceeding" | "exceeding" | "overbearing" (kept for ὑπερηνορέων), "violent", "overweening"; the Odyssey table’s ὑπέρβιος "exceeding" |
| μένος Ἄρηος δατέονται (18.264) | "share out the might of Ares" | "share out the might of war between them" | "divide the fury of Ares" (fury is kept for anger), "deal out"; μένος "might", Ares as war |
| ἀμβροσίη νύξ (18.267–268) | "the ambrosial night" | "the ambrosial night" | "immortal night", "divine night"; follows the table (2.57) |
| σανίδες … ἀραρυῖαι (18.275) | "doors fitted to them" | "doors fitted to them" | "planks", "boards"; follows the table’s σανίδες "doors" |
| ἐΰξεστοι (18.276) | "well-smoothed" | "well-smoothed" | "well-polished", "well-planed"; ξέω "smooth, scrape" |
| εἰρύσσονται (18.276) | "will protect" | "will protect" | "will draw", "will guard" (kept for φυλάσσω) |
| παντοίου δρόμου ἄσῃ (18.281) | "sated with every kind of running" | "given … their fill of every kind of running" | "worn out"; ἄω "satiate" |
| ἠλασκάζων (18.281) | "roaming" | "roams about" | "wandering aimlessly"; ἠλασκάζω |
| κύνες ἀργοί (18.283) | "swift dogs" | "swift dogs" | table’s row, unchanged ("swift" or "white", disputed) |
| φαῖνε νοήματα (18.295) | "show these thoughts" | "show such thoughts" | "reveal", "put forward"; φαίνω "show" |
| νήπιε (18.295, vocative) | "foolish one" | "foolish one" | "fool", "child"; follows the table’s νήπιος "foolish" |
| περνάμενα (κτήματα, 18.292) | "being sold" | "sold" | "traded away", "exported"; πέρνημι "sell" |
| ὠδύσατο (Ζεύς, 18.292) | "grew angry" | "grew angry" | "was wrathful" (kept for μηνίω), "hated"; ὀδύσσομαι |
| ἐκπέρσει (18.283) | "sack" | "sack" | "destroy", "plunder" |
| καταδημοβορῆσαι (18.301) | "to eat up in common" | "to eat up" (+ note: make-up not certain) | "to devour publicly"; the compound’s parts are named and the exact make-up said to be uncertain |
| ἐπαυρέμεν (18.302) | "have the benefit" | "have the benefit of it" | the table’s ἐπαυρήσεσθαι "have the benefit of it" (6.353) |
| δυσηχέος (πολέμοιο, 18.307) | "ill-sounding" | "ill-sounding" | table’s row (2.686), unchanged |
| ἄντην (18.307) | "face to face" | "face to face" | "straight on", "openly" |
| ξυνὸς Ἐνυάλιος (18.309) | "Common is Enyalius" | "Enyalius is common to all" (+ note: Enyalius is a name of the war-god, used for war) | "War is shared" (loses the name) |
| κατέκτα (καί τε, 18.309) | "he kills" | "he kills" (gnomic) | "has killed", "killed"; the aorist after τε states what always happens |
| ὁμοιΐου πολέμοιο (18.242) | "war common to all" | "the war that is common to all" | the table’s 13.358 and 13.634 rows, unchanged |
| ἐγρήγορθε (18.299) | "be wakeful" | "keep awake" | published (iliad-044), unchanged |

Departures from published English: none. Lines 202, 253, 277, 284, 297, 299 (second line), 303, 304 take the packet’s English; at 297 the unit keeps the published ";".
